role: First live large-format Moonpet bot character based on the user-supplied white star-cap pet bot artwork.

visual_direction.pet: large white cyber pet/bot with black visor, pink LED face, white star cap, side headphones, star/planet graphics, paint-splashed jacket, spray can pouch, hanging mini-bot charm and oversized sneakers
visual_direction.background: night rooftop cyber city, purple/blue neon, crescent moon, wet floor reflections, graffiti marks and skyline depth

action_states.description: Default Starcap Moonbot stance over the neon rooftop with status card and star glints.
Snack bowl and energy puffs beside the bot.
Bouncy pet movement with arcade hover ball.
Bubble ring and brightened fresh-visor treatment.
Dimmed rooftop, Z symbols, softer bot energy and rest-cycle panel.
Spray-power energy lines, can prop and stronger neon shadow.

runtime_notes: Loaded by moonpet-game.html after the existing Moonpet Mini App runtime.
Uses a transparent overlay canvas so current gameplay code, controls, API state and HUD remain intact.
The previous black/pink procedural bot drawing has been restyled into the attached white star-cap moonbot direction.
No gameplay API, economy, leaderboard or Telegram auth behaviour is changed by this art pass.
